spans.s: AT0113 गरमणि garamaṇi Different types of gems which are antidotes of poisons.
AT0115 गरसंयोगजं garasaṁyogajaṁ Artificially prepared poison by the combination of various substances.

AT0114 गरसंज्ञम् garasaṁjñam Garavisha is considered as one of the form of kritrim visha (artificial poison) which gets formed by the combination of two or more poisonous or non poisonous drugs and ultimately affects the whole body by vitiating all the dhatus (tissues) in the body. It can go to such extent that it alleviates the dhatus drastically which in turn could prove to be fatal. A phenomenon similar to drug interaction.
SR0132 गर्भकोष garbhakoṣa Bag of fetal membrane
SR0133 गर्भकोष्ठः garbhakoṣṭhaḥ Uterus/Bag of fetal membrane. The organ of female reproductive system for containing and nourishing the embryo.
SR0131 गर्भच्छिद्रं garbhacchidraṁ Os uteri. Mouth of uterus.
RS0071 गर्भद्रुति garbhadruti It is one of the mercurial process where the material is made to melt inside the mercury
SR0134 गर्भनाभिनाडी garbhanābhināḍī Umbilical cord. The attachment connecting the fetus with the placenta
SR0135 गर्भशय्या garbhaśayyā Uterus. The organ of female reproductive system for containing and nourishing the embryo.
SR0130 गर्भाशयः garbhāśayaḥ Uterus. The organ of female reproductive system for containing and nourishing the embryo.
SK0078 गर्भोत्पाद garbhotpāda Conception, fertilization, production of progeny
